content: Alternatives to eBay Marketplace Insights API for sold-price data: (1) apply for Application Growth Check anyway with a legitimate resale-analytics business case, worth attempting early; (2) PriceCharting API (paid, premium tier) aggregates eBay sold data for trading cards/sealed product into a licensed price index - viable fallback that avoids direct scraping; (3) manual/eBay-native Terapeak Research 2.0 in Seller Hub - UI only, no bulk API, not automatable; (4) third-party scraping services (ScrapingBee, ZIK Analytics) - explicitly excluded by project's no-scraping constraint.
